terms.comment: Our description: Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for coconut milk. Nux Indica is the coconut (Marco Polo, Mattioli, Vives, in M-O s.v. coconut), and Morgan–Owens has lac sojae for soy milk, so lac is already stretched from animal milk to plant drinks.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.vv. coconut; legume: soy milk.
